full_page.content:
Page 125 Cont.
May 1st Mary McKimnan - 32 - mother of 4 children - written about in the newspaper. Out of work only support of her children - now in legal difficulty
1st
James Mc Callian - 11 gallstone trouble very threatening
Ist Eliz. Sink - 28 - strep -- blood-infection
2 E'd Spencer - 63 - Lukemia and heart trouble - now in Mayo Bros' - has been away from Church & Sacraments a long time - fear - lest he die irrepentant
Fred Nieman - 59 - heart-trouble and asthma.
Mrs. Mildred Fitzstephens - 37 - give birth to 3rd baby three months ago ... serious nerve trouble ..
Page 126 May 4th Marg. Boyle - 22 of Toronto C'a - cancer of intestines; given up as hopeless. Enrolled To-day - Aunt promising perpetual enrollment and reading of a book "City of God" if Niece is spared
5th Charles Walters - 10 - Muscular dystrophy - has not been able to walk or stand since last November. Otherwise a perfect boy up to about two years. Mother (Episcopl) wonders if boy will live a month. Drs. have no hope in their science. They refuse to have anything more to do with the boy
Bernard Tepatti - 40 - T.B. for over two yrs. in Kiefer Hosp. - has two children & wife
7 Raymond Bessette - 5 - has never walked - 3 yrs. in Ann Arbor Hospital ..... Enrolled To-day
8 Kasimir Sinarej - 30 - in T. B. San (Northville) has been away from - for quite .... Refuses to go to Confession
Thanks ----- Eleanor Troy - 30 - in Ann Arbor Hosp. almost two yrs. after 8 operations - seven ribs - now quite improving - Temperature was 106
9 Raymond Jaskolski - 10 - infantile ... since birth ... Understands every- thing but can hardly say a word - received H. Communion last year and since that has no more convulsions. When asked if he wants to be a priest he tries to answer an Emphatic "Yes".
Page 127
